verdict.rationale: The evidence only glances at this story. The crypto docs tagline says businesses can "hold and earn stablecoins" (probe-2), and holding a USDC/OUSD balance is limited to "eligible businesses" in available countries (docs-22/34). Bridge Open Issuance describes a "fully-backed" stablecoin whose treasury reserves can generate revenue for the issuer (docs-38/39). None of this sets out reserve composition, attestations, or the terms of the yield program. Missing for 10: documented reserve composition, third-party attestation reports, yield/rewards rates and eligibility criteria, plainly stated regulatory caveats on rewards, independent corroboration.
